messages:
deploybot: Deploy kickoff: release=v1.3.7 image=sha:abc123def -> canary pool (10 nodes)

jordan: copying preflight notes here — running smoke + schema-checks now.

maya: quick reminder: feature-flag 'new-token-cache' starts OFF by default in canary. ops to toggle if we need the new path.

ops-jen: link to the lightweight backout runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/soft-rewind — follow the "soft-rewind" flow for canary (steps 1-4). DB emergency path: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/db-rollback

liam: Backout gates I'm watching (call these loudly if crossed):
- sustained 5xx rate > 0.3% over 3m
- p95 latency > 300ms for 5m
- any migration lock or connection pool exhaustion on db-primary
If any hit, we backout and pin previous image (sha: zyx987cba).

jordan: smoke results: 5/5 endpoints ok. p50=42ms p95=182ms. no obvious errors.

deploybot: Canary ramp: 10% -> 20% (now). Observability: https://dash.redwood/internal/deploys/v1.3.7 (watch panels: errors, p95, redis miss rate, db connections).

sre-bot: automated alert rule deployed for this canary: errors.alert if 5xx > 0.25% for 2m (pager off, slack only). Manual escalation if outages start.

maya: Planning ramp to 50% in 12m. ops-jen — please hold DB connection checks at minute +6 and +12.

ops-jen: acknowledged. preflight DB locks are clear. if we need to run the DB quick-undo, follow the runbook snippet below (soft step):
```
# soft-rewind (canary)
deployctl traffic shift --from canary --to stable --percent 100
deployctl pin --pool stable --image sha:zyx987cba
ffctl set new-token-cache off --scope canary
# validate smoke again, then notify release channel
```

liam: Pin command for quick copy: `deployctl pin --pool stable --image sha:zyx987cba` — keep that ready. Also shout when you trigger so SRE knows to avoid concurrent rollforward.

release-coordinator: leaving release notes stub: https://notes.redwood/releases/v1.3.7 — I'll add backout section and the pin sha once we finalize.

jordan: check on infra: redis miss-rate currently 0.7% (baseline 0.5%). will recheck after ramp.

maya: if miss-rate increases >1.5% or p95 jumps > 250ms we pause ramp and run cache warmup.

liam: TL;DR for this thread:
- Soft-rewind runbook (canary) is the primary backout path: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/soft-rewind
- DB emergency rollback has separate steps: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/db-rollback
- Hard pin (stable image) to use: sha:zyx987cba
- Backout triggers: 5xx>0.3% (3m), p95>300ms (5m), migration lock or pool exhaustion

ops-jen: if anyone triggers backout, please include these fields in the comms: who, timestamp, which pool, which image pinned, reason (metric+window), link to runbook step executed.

jordan: ramp to 50% started. monitoring closely; will post next check-in in 8m. :eyes:
